note: Adapted from the original English description by Emerson 1925. Published as Kalotermes (Cryptotermes ?) cubicoceps, sp. nov., based on a single soldier (collected in a dry vine stem); the alate and the other castes are unknown. Because the stylus-like appendages (styli) of this soldier are distinct and not reduced, which disagrees with the subgeneric characters defined by Holmgren, the author leaves its subgeneric assignment in doubt.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head short and thick, nearly square in anterior view: the frons concave, with a thick ridge between the frons and the vertex and another between the frons and each side; the frons with 2 pairs of short rounded tubercles, one pair at the sides of the mandibular bases, one pair at the sides of the clypeus. Head yellowish brown, the frons black, the whole head with only 2—3 setae. Abdominal stylus-like appendages distinct, not reduced, differing from Holmgren's definition of the subgenus as having reduced styli.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, the frons black; head with only 2—3 setae; head short and thick, the frons concave, with a thick ridge between the frons and the vertex and between the frons and each side. The frons with 2 pairs of short rounded tubercles, one pair at the base of each mandible, one pair beside each side of the clypeus. Vertex nearly concave at the frons, otherwise smooth and convex; the ridge between the vertex and the frons deeply concave in the middle; ridge and frons surface with small tubercles. Antennae yellow, 12-segmented; segment 3 shorter than segment 4, segment 4 shorter than segment 2. Compound eyes almost invisible, concolorous with the head. Mandibles short, black. Pronotum yellowish brown, with numerous setae; anterior margin broadly concave, the sides rounded, the posterior margin nearly straight; the corners between the anterior margin and the sides rounded. Abdominal tergites pale, with numerous setae; stylus-like appendages present, not reduced. Measurements (mm): total body length 5.88, head length 2.65, head width 2.12, antennal length 1.53, pronotum length 1.23, pronotum width 1.88, hind tibia length 1.25.
